$schema: Datum family app summary, read by the Datum hub site (github.com/Edgar-Mendonca/Datum) and by File › Roadmap in the app.
name: Datum Plan
tagline: Plan, schedule, track and report your projects: one small, fast app for Windows.
for: Project managers, planners, engineers and contractors.
highlights: A task sheet that works like a spreadsheet, with formula columns and Sheets tabs.
Critical path to the minute: calendars, constraints, all link types, levelling.
Resources, man-hours and costs; Tracking Gantt with 11 baselines; earned value and S-curves.
Dashboard, progress reports and a report builder; print to PDF from every view.
Network Diagram on a whiteboard canvas; timeline with a zoom box; Excel export with formulas.

roadmap.title: Trust in the dates
items: Hundreds more engine tests, one set per area: calendars, constraints, link types, levelling, progress.
Sample plans checked date by date against the results of other scheduling tools.
Every import (XML, XER, MPX, Excel) checked against damaged and unusual files, with a report of what changed.

roadmap.title: Risk and resources
items: Schedule risk analysis (Monte Carlo): P50 and P80 finish dates and costs, tornado chart, criticality.
Roles and skills, with histograms by trade; manpower curves planned against actual.
One resource pool shared by several plans.
A preview before levelling, showing what moves.

roadmap.title: Progress history
items: Actual S-curve built from the saved period snapshots.
Earned schedule, so schedule performance stays meaningful near the end.
Progress from installed quantities (rules of credit).
A 3-week look-ahead with a constraint log.

roadmap.title: Command line and automation
items: datum-cli: open, schedule, change and export plans from the command line.
Every action is a named command shared by the ribbon, Tell Me and the command line.
Connect AI assistants to build and update plans; costs stored exactly in whole cents.

roadmap.title: Schedule quality and scenarios
items: A schedule health score with its trend; baseline compare with ghost bars; a log of logic changes; a milestone trend chart.
What-if scenarios: branch a plan, change it, compare side by side, keep or discard.
Delay analysis: as-planned against as-built, time impact, windows.
Line of balance and takt planning for repetitive work.

roadmap.title: Portfolio and hardening
items: Master plans with subprojects, links between projects, a portfolio dashboard.
Smooth with 100,000 tasks; a signed installer (no Windows warning); crash reports.
Exchange files checked against real files from other tools; custom fields and codes in exported files.

roadmap.title: Working together
items: Shared plans in a shared folder, with check-out per WBS so no one overwrites anyone.
Comments on tasks, an audit trail, progress updates from a phone.

roadmap.title: Stable
items: Text styles by task type, saved custom views, a user guide, a frozen file format.
